mr_title: fix(assets): make srcset parsing HTML spec compliant

expected_issues.title: srcset parsing drops single-character unquoted URLs
expected_issues.description: The unquoted URL alternative [^,]\S*[^,] requires at least two characters. A valid srcset="a" produces no candidates, so processSrcSetSync() emits an empty value and never calls the asset replacer. The former parser accepted this URL. Accept a one-character URL without losing comma handling. Reproduced using the snapshot parser by corpora/curated/audit/reproduce.py.
